description: This file implements priority queue data structures and algorithms, including insertion, removal, swapping, reversing, and peeking operations, tailored for a specific project with custom comparison logic.

methods.name: int compare(struct prio_queue * queue,size_t i,size_t j)
methods.description: Compares two elements in the priority queue based on custom comparison function and control data.

methods.name: void swap(struct prio_queue * queue,size_t i,size_t j)
methods.description: Swaps two elements in the priority queue array.

methods.name: void prio_queue_reverse(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Reverses the order of elements in the priority queue, only applicable for LIFO queues.

methods.name: void clear_prio_queue(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Clears all elements from the priority queue, freeing memory.

methods.name: void prio_queue_put(struct prio_queue * queue,void * thing)
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the priority queue, maintaining heap properties if applicable.

methods.name: void sift_down_root(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Maintains heap property by sifting down the root element.

methods.name: void * prio_queue_get(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the top-priority element from the queue.

methods.name: void * prio_queue_peek(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Returns the top-priority element without removing it.

methods.name: void prio_queue_replace(struct prio_queue * queue,void * thing)
methods.description: Replaces the top element with a new element, maintaining heap properties.

ctags.name: compare
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int compare(struct prio_queue *queue, size_t i, size_t j)$/

ctags.name: swap
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void swap(struct prio_queue *queue, size_t i, size_t j)$/
